title: EnglishDraft
description: Hindi in, English out — the other direction from /translate, for a reader who knows what they want to say. Carries the words worth keeping and a few other ways to say the same thing, because the first English a learner is handed is rarely the one their situation wants.

english.description: Natural English for what the Hindi says — what a fluent speaker would actually write, not a word-by-word rendering.

vocab.description: The English words or phrases in the answer worth learning, each with the bit of Hindi it stands for.

alternatives.description: The same thing said differently, so the reader can pick what fits the person they are writing to.
